answer: Require each identity to present one enrollment attestation from a university, verified through the registrar, with only a hash stored. A sybil farmer can script a thousand accounts, but each fake needs a distinct enrollment, and a duplicate hash is rejected at once, so cost grows student by student. The horizon for trust is not one check: enrollment is rechecked each epoch, and one forgery unravels its whole comet trail of linked accounts, since every registration leaves the same delta of registrar records behind it. Limit: it excludes non-students, and enrollment data must stay hashed.
